subject: ZetaHealth — post-demo burn projection + founders' pathway
body:
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@zetahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZetaHealth — post-demo burn projection + founders' pathway

Sam — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and clear next steps so we can get you a firm price and an incentive proposal for your pilot.

Key signals from the call (my notes):
- Primary workload: chat summarization + medical note generation with peak prompt length ~1200 tokens, avg generation ~350 tokens.
- Estimated daily active users for pilot: 30–50 (spikes expected during charting windows).
- Target latency: p99 < 350ms on short queries; willing to accept higher latency on long form summarization.
- Current tooling: on-prem EHR with SSO; data residency required in US.
- Budget range discussed: $8k–$25k/month depending on quality and SLA.

Requested from you: the three-volume scenarios we talked through (conservative / expected / aggressive). I attached a burn worksheet (zeta_burn_sheet_v1.xlsx) where I populated the conservative and expected rows with the numbers you shared on the call. Please update the aggressive column if that looks off.

Proposal notes / what we're offering next:
1) Ballpark unit: $/1M tokens anchor — I used $650/1M tokens in the sheet for the expected profile (includes Redwood hosted API + 3% routing/fallback buffer).
2) Founders' pathway: you mentioned being an early-stage spinout. We can propose a founders' pathway that layers a 30% starter credit for the first 3 months, then a graduated committed-use discount if you sign a 6–12 month reservation. I attached a short summary of that program (redwood_founders_pathway_summary.pdf).
3) Committed-use pricing: flexible tiers by monthly tokens; multi-year sweeteners (rebates at renewal) are on the table for >12 month commitments.

Next steps I'm proposing:
- You update the xlsx with your aggressive forecast (ETA Tue 5/4 morning).
- Redwood drafts a 1-page commercial summary + a pilot SOW and sends a DocuSign (if procurement is happy) by Wed 5/6.
- Ben (cc'd) will review any non-standard discount asks (>35%) prior to legal/finance review.

Attachments: zeta_burn_sheet_v1.xlsx (editable), redwood_founders_pathway_summary.pdf (program terms), proposal_v1.pdf (placeholder).

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

-----
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@zetahealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@zetahealth.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZetaHealth — post-demo burn projection + founders' pathway

Tessa — really helpful notes, thanks. A few clarifications:
- The 350 token average I gave was for the final summary piece only; overall average across all interactions is closer to 220 tokens. I updated the cells in the conservative/expected sheets, left aggressive blank for you to propose.
- We absolutely need U.S. data residency; can you confirm Redwood Private or Dedicated options in us-west?
- On the founders' pathway: our CFO is open to a 6 month commit but we need to see effective unit economics. If you can show a quick $/1M sensitivity (we're aiming for <$500/1M net effective in Year 1 after credits) that would help.

Procurement looped in for SOW/comments.

Sam
VP Product, ZetaHealth

-----
On Mon, May 03, 2027 at 09:08:00 -0700 tessa_morgan@redwood.ai wrote:
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@zetahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, procurement@zetahealth.com
Subject: Re: ZetaHealth — post-demo burn projection + founders' pathway

Sam — thanks for the fast update. Two clarifications inline plus an ask: can you confirm the % of requests that will be long-form summarization vs quick retrieval responses? that changes the latency profile and effective token ratio.

I took your 220 avg and re-ran the sheet; attached is a short sensitivity table inside the workbook but key highlights here:
- Conservative (month 1 pilot): ~45M tokens/month => list $/1M = $725 => gross bill $32,600/month.
- Expected: ~120M tokens/month => list $/1M = $650 => gross bill $78,000/month.
- Aggressive (your fill expected): placeholder at 300M tokens/month => list $/1M = $600 => gross bill $180,000/month.

Founders' pathway proposal (first-pass, non-binding):
- Month 1–3: 30% starter credits applied to invoice (applies to hosted usage only).
- Months 4–9: If you convert to a 6mo committed reservation (paid monthly), we apply a 20% committed-use discount off list for reserved volumes; effective $/1M moves ~20–35% depending on tiering.
- Multi-year: 12+ month commitments eligible for an additional renewal rebate of up to 10% payable at year renewal if usage targets are hit.

To meet your target of <$500/1M net in Year 1 after credits, here's a quick pathway: pilot starter credits + 6mo reserved tier at your expected volume gets you to ~ $480/1M effective in month 4–9 in the expected scenario. I documented the math in the workbook.

What I'll do next:
- Ben, can you confirm whether we can extend founders' pathway below 25% net without exec signoff?
- I'll prepare a compact commercial summary that shows the $/1M sensitivity table and the SOW placeholder.

Thanks —
Tessa

Subject: Re: ZetaHealth — post-demo burn projection + founders' pathway

Tessa / Sam — quick callout from pricing: founders' pathway up to 30% starter credit is OK within program rules. Anything beyond that or deeper multi-year rebates will need revenue review and an explicit deal_id escalation. For reference: DEAL-8942 is acceptable to route through our revenue approvals workflow.

Sam — we can support Private deployments in us-west; I'll loop in Solutions to scope network/file transfer details after you confirm the committed volumes. Monica — can you prep a short SOW template we can ship to procurement?

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: procurement@zetahealth.com

Date: Sat, 02 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZetaHealth — post-demo burn projection + founders' pathway

Team — procurement here. We reviewed the workbook and have two asks before legal engages:
1) Please provide a simple pilot SOW (scope, data residency, security attachments) and call out termination/rollback for the pilot.
2) Can Redwood provide a redlined copy of the founders' pathway T&Cs (especially around credits and rebate measurement) or a short one-pager describing how credits are applied?

We prefer DocuSign for the pilot SOW. Please send the materials to procurement@zetahealth.com.

Thanks,
ZetaHealth Procurement
